content.name: Mariam Haddad
content.title: Junior DevOps Engineer
content.summary: Junior DevOps engineer in München with a B.Sc. in Wirtschaftsinformatik and nine months as a Werkstudentin on a cloud operations team. Now maintains GitLab pipelines and Kubernetes deployments for a mobility software company and wrote the automation that ended weekend manual releases. Studying for the CKA.

experience.title: Werkstudentin DevOps
bullets: Wrote Ansible playbooks to patch 120 Ubuntu servers in rolling batches, replacing a manual monthly maintenance evening.
Created a Grafana dashboard for backup job status that the team checked each morning instead of reading log files.
Documented the customer onboarding process in German and English for the service desk.

experience.title: Junior DevOps Engineer
bullets: Automated releases for the ride-pooling back end with GitLab CI and Helm, ending Saturday manual deployments for a team of 14 developers.
Set up Renovate for dependency updates across 22 repositories, reducing open critical vulnerabilities from 41 to 6 in three months.
Moved application secrets from environment files into HashiCorp Vault with per-service access policies.
Wrote a cost report for non-production clusters that led to switching them off at night, saving about €1,900 a month.

education.school: Hochschule München University of Applied Sciences
education.details: Final grade 1.9. Bachelor thesis: cost models for Kubernetes in small and medium-sized companies.

achievements.title: Hackathon prize, university cloud challenge
achievements.detail: Team of three built a carbon-aware job scheduler for a student cluster.

achievements.title: Tutor, Programming I
achievements.detail: Ran weekly Python exercise groups for 25 first-semester students over two semesters.
